targets.from: "Narrow bridged chasms": walls everywhere. Restated from terrain.slopes.over45Percent >= 55: the slope share counts only the wall columns of a country of flat mesa tops and chasm floors (the vanilla Nether reaches 52.8 with a jagged floor); the walls are the drop between the mesa tops, a quarter of the floor at 70 or higher, and the chasm floors below

"chasms", "deeper and deeper": low cut ground. Restated from landforms basins + water >= 35: the landform classifier marks basins by their height against a 256-block window, so the floor of a cut wider than about 128 blocks reads as plains; a quarter of the floor or more lies 50 blocks under the mesa tops (the survey reports quartiles, so the 35% share itself is not measured)
"quartz spans over the wail": chasms, not lava lakes
1.21.1 type nether: a roof over the world
place kind place (one chasm country): one region holds half the land
place kind place: no scatter of biome specks
